user.title: Add an Anchor account
user.description: Each Anchor account is added separately. In Anchor, sign in as the person and copy Settings → API token.

data_description.ha_user_id: Whose Anchor account this is. Dashboards use it to show each person their own notes.
data_description.name: Optional. Defaults to the Home Assistant user's name.
data_description.url: Address of your Anchor server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3000
data_description.api_token: From Anchor: Settings → API token, signed in as this person.

reauth_confirm.title: New Anchor API token
reauth_confirm.description: Anchor rejected the token for {name}. It may have been regenerated or revoked. Paste the current one from Settings → API token.

error.not_anchor: That address answered, but it isn't an Anchor server.
error.invalid_auth: Anchor rejected the API token, or the account is still pending approval.
error.unknown: Unexpected response from Anchor. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Anchor account is already added.
abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different Anchor account.

data.exclude_pinned_from_recent: Leave pinned notes out of recent lists

data_description.ha_user_id: Whose Anchor account this is. Dashboards use it to show each person their own notes.

show_note.name: Show note
show_note.description: Fetches one note in full, with its formatting, into an account's Note viewer sensor for a dashboard to show. The note is kept out of history.

note_id.name: Note ID
note_id.description: The note's ID, as listed in the other Anchor sensors' attributes (or the end of its Anchor web address).

clear_note.name: Clear note
clear_note.description: Empties an account's Note viewer sensor.
